paper.title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
paper.abstract: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as an effective paradigm that augments a shared Large Language Model backbone with auxiliary heads, training the model to predict several future tokens in parallel to enrich its supervision signal and accelerate inference. However, existing training frameworks adopt a rigid, fixed-length prediction horizon, disregarding the highly non-uniform information density of natural language and code. Forcing the auxiliary heads to predict across high-entropy seman

summary.core_problem: 解决 fixed-horizon Multi-Token Prediction 在自然语言和代码中跨越高熵语义边界时产生噪声梯度、干扰主干模型能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是语言建模目标与训练机制改进。MTP 同时关系到预训练监督密度和推理加速，AdaMTP 关注辅助预测头对共享 backbone 的梯度污染，这比单纯报告 MTP 提速更接近预训练研究员需要判断的风险点。
summary.technical_approach: AdaMTP 用 entropy-based segmentation 动态调整多 token 预测长度。方法利用 base model 识别不确定性突然升高的位置，把这些位置视为语义或可预测性边界，避免辅助头被迫预测跨边界的高熵未来 token。相较固定预测步长，它把 horizon 与局部可预测性对齐，以减少辅助 loss 对共享表示的冲突梯度。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明面向自然语言和代码，但给定信息未披露模型规模、训练 token 数、baseline、推理加速倍率或主任务指标提升。需要重点检查 MTP 头数、entropy 阈值、boundary detector 是否泄漏 teacher 信息，以及 AdaMTP 对主干 perplexity、代码任务和 speculative decoding 接口的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Address noisy and conflicting gradients from fixed-horizon Multi-Token Prediction when auxiliary heads are forced to predict across high-entropy semantic boundaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a language-modeling objective and training-mechanism contribution. MTP affects both pretraining supervision density and inference acceleration; AdaMTP focuses on gradient interference from auxiliary heads into the shared backbone, which is the right failure mode to inspect.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaMTP uses entropy-based segmentation to adapt the multi-token prediction horizon. A base model detects sudden uncertainty increases as semantic or predictability boundaries, so auxiliary heads avoid predicting high-entropy future tokens across those boundaries. Compared with fixed-length MTP, the horizon is aligned with local predictability to reduce conflicting gradients on shared representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions natural language and code but does not provide model sizes, token counts, baselines, speedup numbers, or downstream gains. The key checks are the number of MTP heads, entropy thresholds, possible teacher leakage in boundary detection, and effects on backbone perplexity, code tasks, and speculative-decoding compatibility.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻在 MTP 预训练消融中复现；关键不是收益均值，而是跨 entropy boundary 时主干梯度是否真的变脏。
recommendation.en: Replicate this in MTP pretraining ablations; the key is not mean gain but whether backbone gradients degrade across entropy boundaries.

paper.title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
paper.abstract: Can a strictly local, iterated, weight-shared computation primitive support language modelling, and which of those three properties actually drives the model's behaviour? We define \textsc{TextNCA}, a 1D causal windowed-attention realisation of the Neural Cellular Automaton primitive, and study a hierarchical variant that cascades three stages with windows $w \in \{8, 32, 128\}$ and $T_s$ shared-weight iterations per stage, all on WikiText-103 at roughly 30M parameters and 60k training steps. Th

summary.core_problem: 研究严格局部、迭代、权重共享的 Neural Cellular Automata 原语能否支撑语言建模，以及真正影响行为的是哪一个设计因素。
summary.importance: 贡献更像架构分析而非新模型提案。它给出一个小规模负结果：TextNCA 在 WikiText-103 上不如同参数 Transformer，但通过消融指出层级化的窄到宽窗口调度比迭代和权重共享更能解释性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TextNCA，把 1D causal windowed attention 实现成文本版 NCA；层级版本依次使用窗口大小 8、32、128，每个 stage 做若干次共享权重迭代。关键消融包括非迭代 sliding-window Transformer、反转窗口顺序、展平窗口顺序、破坏单调调度等。
summary.experiments: 实验在 WikiText-103 上进行，模型约 30M 参数，训练 60k steps。Hier-TextNCA PPL 为 60.3，弱于 Transformer-6L 的 52.8 和 Transformer-12L 的 44.7；不做迭代但保留相同窄到宽窗口调度的 sliding-window Transformer 只比迭代模型差约 4.1 PPL。
summary.authors_note: Erik Cambria 长期从事 NLP 与情感计算研究；Rajiv Ratn Shah 长期从事多模态与语言相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a strictly local, iterative, weight-shared neural cellular automaton primitive can support language modeling, and which part of that design actually drives the observed behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its value is architectural diagnosis rather than a competitive model claim. The main result is a small-scale negative finding: TextNCA trails parameter-matched Transformers, while the narrow-to-wide hierarchical window schedule explains much of its behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: TextNCA instantiates a 1D causal windowed-attention NCA for text. The hierarchical variant cascades stages with window sizes 8, 32, and 128, with shared-weight iterations within each stage. The paper ablates iteration, weight sharing, reversed schedules, flattened schedules, and disrupted monotonic ordering.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use WikiText-103, roughly 30M parameters, and 60k training steps. Hier-TextNCA reaches 60.3 perplexity, compared with 52.8 for a 6-layer Transformer and 44.7 for a 12-layer Transformer. A non-iterative sliding-window Transformer with the same schedule comes within about +4.1 PPL of the iterative model.
summary_en.authors_note: Erik Cambria is known for NLP and affective computing work; Rajiv Ratn Shah has a long research record in multimodal and language systems.

recommendation.zh: 可看作局部架构的负结果；只读消融表，重点是窗口课程而不是 NCA 叙事。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a negative local-architecture probe; read the ablations, not the NCA framing.

paper.title: LeRoPE: Learnable RoPE Frequencies Improve Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Rotary Positional Encodings (RoPE) are currently the most popular positional encodings used in modern language models. RoPE rotates two-dimensional chunks of query and key vectors, operating as a function of their relative positional offset. The position-wise rates of rotation in RoPE typically follow a geometric sequence specified by a fixed base-frequency hyperparameter. Prior work has improved performance by either increasing this parameter to slow rotation or by applying RoPE to only a subse

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个长期被当作超参数的问题：RoPE 的频率谱是否应该固定为手工设定的几何序列。标准做法把 base frequency 视为架构常数，或者通过 partial RoPE、调大 base 等方式做离线调参；但这些方法都默认“频率形状先验”是对的。论文要回答的是：如果直接把每个频带的频率当作可学习参数，模型会不会学出更合适的位置谱，且这种改动是否在不同规模上稳定带来语言建模收益。作者的结论是肯定的：只增加极少参数，每个频带一个标量，就能在 52M 到 2.5B 的从头训练模型上稳定优于标准 RoPE，并且学出的频率结构在不同规模和随机种子下高度一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在“又一个位置编码变体”，而在两个更具体的点。第一，它说明 RoPE 里最关键的设计量之一——频率分布——并不需要完全手工指定，模型自己能学出更合适的谱，而且收益在从小模型到十亿级模型都存在。对于大规模预训练 recipe，这意味着一个几乎零成本、低风险的改动可以换来可测的 compute 节省。摘要给出的量化结果是：在 2.5B 规模上，标准 RoPE 需要多 3.4% 的训练算力才能追平 LeRoPE。第二，它提供了一个关于“位置与语义如何在频带中分工”的更细观察：训练后会出现一个 dominant positional band，强烈承担位置贡献，而其他慢频带更多保留内容匹配能力。这对理解 partial RoPE、NoPE、长上下文 base scaling 为什么有效，有直接解释力，也会影响后续对可学习位置编码、频谱分配、甚至 head specialization 的研究。
summary.technical_approach:
方法非常克制。作者没有改 attention 形式，也没有引入复杂的相对位置网络，而是在标准 RoPE 上只做一件事：把每个二维频带对应的旋转频率从固定常数改成可学习标量。按文中设定，每个模型只多 32 个参数，说明他们是在每个 head dimension 的频带层面共享这组可学习频率，而不是为每层每头单独学习一大堆参数。这样做保留了 RoPE 的核心性质：query-key 内积仍然只依赖相对位置偏移；同时把“几何频率序列是否合适”交给训练自己决定。

从全文描述看，LeRoPE 的关键不是简单“让频率自由”，而是保留了 RoPE 的结构归纳偏置，只放松最值得放松的一小部分。相比直接改成 learned absolute embedding，它仍然是相对位置编码，因而不会丢掉 RoPE 在长度泛化和 attention 结构上的优点。相比 partial RoPE，它不是手工决定哪些低频带不旋转，而是让优化过程自己决定哪些频带应更慢、近似不旋转，哪些频带应承担更强的位置变化。相比单纯调大 base，它不是对整个频谱做统一缩放，而是允许非均匀重排频率谱。论文分析部分显示，模型最终学出的频率 profile 不是任意散乱的，而是跨尺度、跨种子都很稳定，这说明优化找到的是数据与架构共同偏好的谱形，而不是偶然过拟合。

另一个值得注意的技术点是作者对 attention logits 的频带分解分析。他们不是只报告 perplexity 改善，而是把不同频带对 logits 的位置性贡献拆开，发现会涌现一个 dominant positional band。这个现象很关键，因为它暗示标准 RoPE 的“多频带均匀承担位置编码”并不符合训练后模型的实际使用方式；模型更像是在少数频带上集中编码位置信号，在其他频带上保留更稳定的语义匹配空间。LeRoPE 的收益，很可能来自它让这种分工更容易形成。
summary.experiments:
实验是一个从 52M 到 2.5B 的训练阶梯，全部从头训练，用来检验收益是否随规模稳定。核心结果有两类。

第一类是语言建模主指标。LeRoPE 在所有规模上都优于标准 RoPE。摘要里给出的最明确数字是：在最大 2.5B 模型上，标准 RoPE 需要额外 3.4% 的训练算力才能达到 LeRoPE 的性能。这种表述比单点 perplexity 更有意义，因为它直接说明这是一个 compute-efficient 的 recipe 改动，而不是只在某个 checkpoint 上偶然领先。

第二类是机制分析。作者比较不同随机种子、不同模型规模下学到的频率参数，发现频率 profile 高度一致，说明学习到的不是不稳定的自由度。更重要的是 attention logit 分解结果：会出现一个单独的频带，对位置相关项贡献显著更大，被作者称为 dominant positional band。结合文中对慢频带的讨论，可以推断 LeRoPE 往往会把大部分频带推向更慢、更接近内容通道的状态，同时保留少数频带承担清晰的位置锚点。

从摘要和引言可见，论文还把结果放到 partial RoPE、调 base、NoPE 等已有观察的脉络里解释。精读时要重点找正文中的 scaling 曲线、learned frequency 可视化、以及 attention logit 按 band 分解的图。这几部分比单纯的验证集损失更能说明为什么会提升。

目前给出的全文片段没有列出全部训练 token 数、上下文长度、数据集名称和完整消融表。阅读原文时需要补齐这些具体数字，尤其是：每个规模的训练 token、是否控制了 FLOPs 完全一致、与 partial RoPE / tuned base 的直接对比幅度、以及长上下文外推是否也有测量。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“先结果，后机制”来读。先看实验总表和 scaling 曲线，确认收益是否在所有规模都稳定，以及 3.4% compute gap 是如何测出来的。然后直接看 learned frequency profile 的图，观察它和标准几何频谱的偏离方向：是整体变慢，还是只重排少数频带。接着看 attention logit 的 band-wise 分解，这是全文最有信息量的分析部分，能帮助理解 dominant positional band 的含义。

方法部分本身不长，重点不是公式复杂度，而是参数化选择：每个频带学一个标量，为什么还能保留相对位置性质，为什么比调 base 更灵活、比完全自由的位置编码更稳。若你做预训练 recipe，这篇最值得深挖的是它和 partial RoPE / NoPE 的关系，因为它提供了一个数据驱动版本的“哪些维度该承载位置，哪些维度该保留语义”。

预计泛读 25 到 40 分钟足够抓住主结论；如果要复现或决定是否纳入训练栈，需要再仔细看附录里的初始化、约束方式、学习率处理、以及不同规模下频率收敛形态。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a design choice that has mostly been treated as a fixed hyperparameter: the frequency spectrum in RoPE. Standard RoPE uses a hand-crafted geometric progression controlled by a base frequency. Later variants improved performance by tuning the base or by disabling rotation for part of the spectrum, but they still assume the shape of the spectrum should be manually specified. This work asks a simpler question: what happens if the frequencies themselves are learned during pretraining? The answer is that learning one scalar per frequency band consistently improves language modeling across models from 52M to 2.5B parameters, while adding only a negligible number of parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its significance is practical and conceptual. Practically, it is a near-zero-cost recipe change with measurable compute benefit. The abstract reports that at 2.5B scale, standard RoPE needs 3.4% more training compute to match LeRoPE. That is the kind of gain that matters in large pretraining runs because it comes without architectural disruption. Conceptually, the paper sharpens the picture of how positional and semantic information are distributed across RoPE bands. The learned models consistently develop a single dominant positional band, while slower bands appear to preserve content matching. This helps explain why partial RoPE, NoPE-like behavior in some dimensions, and base scaling for long context often work in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is deliberately minimal. Instead of changing attention or introducing a new positional network, the paper keeps the RoPE mechanism and replaces fixed band frequencies with learnable scalars. In the reported setup this adds only 32 parameters per model, which suggests the learned frequencies are shared at the band level rather than expanded per layer and per head. The key point is that the relative-position property of RoPE is preserved: the rotated query-key inner product still depends only on relative offset, but the spectrum is no longer forced to follow a predetermined geometric schedule.

What makes the approach interesting is not just added flexibility, but selective relaxation of the right inductive bias. Compared with learned absolute embeddings, LeRoPE remains a relative positional encoding and therefore keeps the structural advantages of RoPE. Compared with partial RoPE, it does not require manually deciding which low-frequency bands should stop rotating. Compared with changing the base, it does not apply a uniform rescaling to the whole spectrum; it allows non-uniform redistribution across bands. The analysis shows that the learned spectra are highly consistent across scales and random seeds, which argues against the improvement being a fragile optimization artifact.

A second technical contribution is the analysis of attention logits by frequency band. Rather than stopping at perplexity, the paper decomposes positional contributions across bands and finds the emergence of a dominant positional band. This suggests that trained models do not use the RoPE spectrum uniformly. Instead, they seem to concentrate explicit positional signaling in a small part of the spectrum while leaving other bands closer to content channels. LeRoPE appears to help the model discover this allocation more efficiently.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is a scale ladder from 52M to 2.5B parameters, all trained from scratch. The main empirical result is simple and strong: LeRoPE outperforms standard RoPE at every scale. The clearest quantitative statement in the abstract is that at 2.5B scale, standard RoPE requires 3.4% more compute to match LeRoPE. That framing is more informative than a single validation-loss delta because it directly translates into pretraining efficiency.

The analysis results are equally important. Learned frequency profiles are highly consistent across random seeds and model sizes, which indicates that the optimization is finding a stable preferred spectrum rather than exploiting arbitrary extra degrees of freedom. The paper also shows that one band emerges with a much larger positional contribution to the attention logits than the others, termed the dominant positional band. This supports the view that the useful role of the RoPE spectrum is not evenly distributed.

From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper situates its findings relative to partial RoPE, base tuning, and NoPE. When reading the full paper, the most important figures to inspect are the scaling curves, the learned-frequency visualizations, and the band-wise logit decomposition. Those explain the gain better than the headline language-modeling metric alone.

The excerpt does not include all training details such as total tokens, context length, dataset names, or the full ablation table. Those should be checked in the full paper, especially direct comparisons against tuned-base RoPE and partial RoPE under matched FLOP budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the main scaling results and verify that the gain is consistent across the full model ladder. Then look at how the 3.4% compute gap is measured. After that, go straight to the learned-frequency plots and compare them with the standard geometric spectrum: is the change mostly a global slowing, or a selective reshaping of a few bands? The next section to read carefully is the band-wise attention-logit analysis, because that is where the dominant positional band is identified.

The method section itself should be quick to read. The important questions are not mathematical complexity but parameterization and invariance: why one scalar per band is enough, how the relative-position property is preserved, and why this is a safer modification than fully learned positional embeddings. If your interest is pretraining recipe design, the most useful angle is the connection to partial RoPE and NoPE. LeRoPE can be read as a data-driven version of deciding which dimensions should carry position and which should remain semantically stable.

A skim should take about 25 to 40 minutes. If you are considering adoption, spend extra time on the appendix for initialization, constraints on the learned frequencies, optimizer treatment, and convergence patterns across scales.

recommendation.zh: 位置编码的扎实改进，全尺度验证有效，应立刻在内部预训练ablation中加入LeRoPE对照，重点看2.5B规模的FLOPs等价性实验。
recommendation.en: A solid positional encoding improvement validated across all scales — add LeRoPE to internal pretraining ablations immediately, focus on the 2.5B FLOP-equivalence experiments.

paper.title: Set Diffusion: Interpolating Token Orderings Between Autoregression and Diffusion for Fast and Flexible Decoding
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have steadily improved in quality relative to autoregressive (AR) models. However, these models are normally constrained to fixed-length generation and do not support key-value (KV) caching. Block diffusion partially bridges diffusion and AR by generating token blocks left-to-right, but its fixed-size sequential blocks limit decoding flexibility and parallelism. Here, we present a new class of language models, set diffusion, comprised of (i) a likelihood parameterizatio

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是离散 diffusion language model 在解码形态上的两个硬限制：多数模型需要固定长度、全双向上下文，难以做 KV cache；block diffusion 虽然把 diffusion 放进左到右的块内生成，支持变长和部分缓存，但块大小和块顺序固定，导致 infilling、任意位置插入、滑动窗口生成不自然，并且一个 block 内部完成前不能更新 KV cache。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对非 AR 语言建模有直接参考价值。它不是简单调 block size，而是把生成单位从连续 block 改成任意位置、任意长度的 token set，用生成顺序来插值 AR 和 diffusion。这个角度比较关键：AR 的优势来自可缓存和稳定的条件分解，diffusion 的优势来自并行和任意顺序生成；set diffusion 试图把两者放在同一个 likelihood parameterization 里，而不是只在采样器层面做折中。对预训练研究的启发在于，非 AR LM 如果要进入通用语言建模，必须同时处理 likelihood、变长生成、缓存、任意位置编辑这几个接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是定义一个对 token set 自回归分解的语言模型。每一步不再生成一个 token，也不要求生成固定连续 block，而是生成一个 flexible-position、flexible-length 的 token 集合。固定左到右连续集合时，它退化为 block diffusion；集合大小为 1 且严格左到右时，接近普通 AR；集合位置更随机、集合更大时，则更接近 diffusion 的并行去噪。模型还引入 set-causal diffusion architecture，使已完成的 token set 可以在每个推理 step 后写入 KV cache，而不是像 block diffusion 那样等整个 block 去噪结束。解码时可以选择不同 ordering policy，例如偏左到右、随机位置、用于 infilling 的任意位置补全，因而把质量、速度、可编辑性放进同一个可调空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理、摘要、无条件生成和 infilling。论文报告 set diffusion 在多个任务上比已有 diffusion LM 有更好的速度-质量折中，并且在 infilling 上明显优于 block diffusion。图 1 给出的 GSM8K 曲线显示，set diffusion 在约 80 到 160 tokens/sec 的范围内取得约 55% 到 65% 的测试准确率，曲线整体优于 block diffusion 的对应设置。实验重点不是单点分数，而是不同生成顺序、集合大小和缓存策略带来的 Pareto 曲线变化。消融最值得看的是 ordering bias 和 set size 对质量、并行度、KV-cache 更新频率的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认它相对 block diffusion 解决了什么具体接口问题。随后看方法部分中 likelihood factorization over sets 和 set-causal attention mask 的定义，这是核心创新。实验部分重点看 GSM8K speed-accuracy 曲线、infilling 对比、以及不同 token ordering 的消融。背景部分可以快速跳过，除非需要补齐 D3PM、MDLM、block diffusion 的公式关系。
summary.authors_note: Cornell University Department of Computer Science；文中通信作者为 Marianne Arriola，代码仓库位于 kuleshov-group/setdlms，显示与 Kuleshov group 相关。完整作者列表无法从给定内容确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation of discrete diffusion language models: they usually require fixed-length generation and bidirectional context, which makes variable-length decoding and KV caching difficult. Block diffusion improves this by generating left-to-right blocks, but fixed contiguous blocks still constrain infilling, arbitrary-position insertion, and parallel decoding. It also cannot update the KV cache until a whole block has been denoised.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a cleaner interface between autoregressive language modeling and diffusion-style denoising. Instead of interpolating by changing a fixed block size, the paper interpolates by changing the order and size of token sets. This matters for pretraining research because non-AR language models need more than fast sampling; they need a likelihood parameterization, variable-length generation, cache compatibility, and editing-friendly decoding. Set diffusion is an attempt to put these requirements into one modeling family.
summary_en.technical_approach: Set diffusion defines an autoregressive distribution over flexible token sets. A decoding step can generate tokens at arbitrary positions and with arbitrary set sizes. If the sets are constrained to fixed contiguous left-to-right blocks, the model recovers block diffusion. If the sets become singletons with a left-to-right order, the behavior approaches AR decoding. If the sets are larger and more randomly ordered, the behavior moves toward diffusion-style parallel denoising. The architecture uses a set-causal design so that completed sets can be committed to the KV cache after every inference step. This is the key difference from block diffusion, where within-block bidirectional denoising delays cache updates.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates mathematical reasoning, summarization, unconditional generation, and infilling. The reported results emphasize speed-quality tradeoffs rather than a single operating point. In the GSM8K plot, set diffusion operates roughly in the 80 to 160 tokens/sec range with about 55% to 65% test accuracy, and its curve is better than the block diffusion curve shown in the figure. The paper also reports strong gains over block diffusion on infilling, where arbitrary-position sets are a natural fit. The most informative ablations are the ones varying generation order, set size, and the degree of left-to-right bias.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand the failure mode of block diffusion. Then read the method sections defining the set-factorized likelihood and the set-causal architecture. In the experiments, focus on the GSM8K speed-accuracy curve, the infilling results, and ablations over ordering policies. The diffusion background can be skimmed unless the reader wants to verify the relation to D3PM, MDLM, and block diffusion.
summary_en.authors_note: Cornell University Department of Computer Science. The supplied text lists Marianne Arriola as the corresponding author and links code under kuleshov-group/setdlms, indicating involvement from the Kuleshov group. The full author list is not available in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 集扩散突破了离散扩散的固定块限制，同时兼容KV缓存，对提升扩散LM的推理效率与实用性很有启发，重点看集因果架构设计。
recommendation.en: Set diffusion breaks the fixed-block constraint of discrete diffusion while supporting KV caching, insightful for improving diffusion LM inference efficiency; focus on the set-causal architecture.

paper.title: Explicit Fuzzy Logic in the Feed-Forward Layer: Self-Forgetting Quantifiers Discover Legible Grammatical-Licensing Detectors
paper.abstract: A transformer's feed-forward (FFN) sublayer materializes the distinctions attention gathers, yet gives no account of what it computes. In a parameter-neutral replacement, each hidden unit is an explicit fuzzy set operation on sigmoid-bounded [0,1] memberships: intersection A*B and set-difference A*(1-B), the latter a bounded positive negation ("A but not B") that gated/bilinear units lack -- a negation-capable FFN (NC-FFN). On N-bit parity they are the most parameter-efficient reasoning basis at

summary.core_problem: Transformer 的 FFN 到底在计算什么，以及能否用显式、可解释的逻辑运算替代常规 GELU/门控 FFN 而不明显损失语言建模性能。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制与架构边界探索工作。价值不在于直接给出更强基座模型，而在于把 FFN 的一部分功能重写成可读的模糊逻辑算子，并观察哪些语言现象能被这种显式结构捕获、哪些不能。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 NC-FFN，用参数量不增加的方式把每个隐藏单元写成显式模糊集合运算，包括交集 A*B 和集合差 A*(1-B)，后者提供普通 gated/bilinear FFN 不具备的正向有界否定能力。实验发现两元逻辑主要局限在底层且会在训练中退化，于是进一步加入一小块序列量词模块，包括软存在量词和软比例量词，并为每个单元学习遗忘率，以处理语法许可和量词相关现象。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出两类结果：在 N-bit parity 上，NC-FFN 在浅层设定下是参数效率最高的推理基元之一；在 125M、OpenWebText 规模上，语言建模困惑度可与 GELU 基线打平。作者还报告一个集中缺陷：若只用 token 内两元逻辑，模型在 grammatical licensing 和 quantifier 相关能力上表现不足，引入序列量词后可缓解。没有看到更大规模训练，因此对大模型外推价值有限。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington。论文风格偏可解释性与结构归纳偏置研究，不是主流大规模预训练路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what Transformer FFNs are actually computing, and whether explicit interpretable logic operators can replace standard GELU/gated FFNs without hurting language modeling.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-architecture boundary exploration. Its value is not in delivering a stronger foundation model, but in rewriting part of the FFN into legible fuzzy-logic operators and probing which linguistic phenomena such structure can and cannot capture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes NC-FFN, a parameter-neutral FFN replacement where each hidden unit is an explicit fuzzy-set operation, including intersection A*B and set difference A*(1-B). The latter provides a bounded positive negation that standard gated or bilinear units lack. The author finds that two-operand logic localizes to lower layers and erodes during training, then adds a small sequence-quantifier block with a soft existential, a soft proportion operator, and learned forgetting rates to better handle grammatical licensing and quantification.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports two main findings: on N-bit parity, NC-FFN is highly parameter-efficient at shallow depth; at 125M scale on OpenWebText, it matches the perplexity of a GELU baseline. A concentrated weakness appears in grammatical licensing and quantifier phenomena when only within-token two-operand logic is used, and sequence quantifiers help address it. There is no evidence yet at larger scales, so the implications for frontier pretraining remain limited.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the University of Washington. The work is closer to interpretability and inductive-bias research than to mainstream large-scale pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 更像可解释 FFN 的概念验证，不会立刻改你的训练栈；若你关心 FFN 机制，只看它对 licensing/quantifier 缺陷的分析即可。
recommendation.en: This is more a proof-of-concept for interpretable FFNs than a recipe changer; if you care about FFN mechanisms, read the part on licensing and quantifier failures.

paper.title: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Delta-rule linear attention improves recurrent memory updates by correcting what is already stored at the current write address before writing new content. However, the active correction is still anchored to that same write address. As a result, stale information stored at a different address cannot be actively removed before new content is written elsewhere. We propose Erase-then-Delta Attention (EDA), a memory update rule that decouples where to erase from where to write. The key insight is th

summary.core_problem: Delta-rule 线性注意力/递归记忆模型里，“纠错(erase/correct)”与“写入(write)”被同一个写地址 key 绑定：模型只能在当前写入地址上做 delta 纠错，无法在写新内容到地址 A 的同时，主动去地址 B 删除过期信息。结果是遇到变量重赋值、事实更正、上下文切换这类需要“定点删除”的场景时，只能依赖全局/通道级衰减去慢慢忘，容易残留干扰。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在“长上下文与常数状态模型”的训练动态与记忆管理：它给 delta-rule 递归记忆补上了一个更像显式内存系统的操作原语——独立寻址的擦除。若结论成立，这类更新规则能在不回到 KV-cache 的前提下，缓解状态污染(state contamination)，提升长序列建模稳定性与可控性。贡献量级属于“更新规则层面的结构改动”，比纯调参/门控小修更有可迁移性，但仍需要看在更大规模预训练与更长上下文下是否保持收益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在 channel-wise gated delta / DPLR（对角衰减 + 低秩写入/纠错）的递归记忆框架上。基线 delta-rule 的关键是：把记忆矩阵 S_t 当作关联记忆，针对当前写 key k_t，让读出 S^T k_t 逼近 v_t，通过一次“delta 纠错”更新 S，从而不是简单累加 k_t v_t^T。

EDA 的核心改动是把“要抑制/擦除的地址”从当前写地址 k_t 解耦出来：
1) Erase step：先选择一个独立的 erase address（论文表述为 independently chosen address），沿着学习到的 erase direction 对该地址相关的记忆痕迹做定向抑制；这一步的语义更接近“条件化清理”，而不是统一的衰减。
2) Delta step：再在当前写地址 k_t 上做标准 delta-style corrective write，保留 delta-rule 的优势（纠错式写入、减少写入漂移）。

作者强调这是“严格更丰富”的更新族：同一步里允许 erase@addr_e 与 write@addr_w 并存，而以往方法（包括把 delta gate 拆成 key-side erase / value-side write 的变体）仍然围绕当前写 key 组织编辑。

从机制上，EDA 试图把三种记忆管理信号分离清楚：对角/通道级 decay（无地址）、独立寻址 erase（有地址但不等于写地址）、写地址上的 delta 纠错（有地址且与写绑定）。论文还报告模型会学到 erase 与 write 近似正交的寻址分离，暗示两者确实承担不同功能，而不是“更强的同址遗忘”。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表格与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述参数规模、数据规模、PPL/下游指标提升幅度等硬结果。根据引言，实验覆盖三类：
- 语言模型预训练：EDA 相对 DPLR-style gated delta baseline 有提升，并与若干强更新规则变体对比。
- 长上下文评测：用于验证常数状态模型在长序列下的收益是否扩大。
- 记忆状态探针/分析：观察 erase 与 write 的寻址关系，作者声称出现“近似正交分离”。

建议在阅读时直接以主表（LM loss/PPL、long-context 指标）和消融（去掉 erase、把 erase 强行绑定到 write、只增强 decay 等）为准，确认收益来自“独立寻址擦除”而不是额外参数/门控容量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先抓三块：
1) 方法公式：把 EDA 的 erase step 写成对 S_t 的什么形式的更新、erase address 如何参数化、与 DPLR/通道衰减如何组合；重点看它是否引入额外的低秩项/额外头维度，以及计算/显存开销是否仍是 O(1) state。
2) 关键消融：a) erase 与 write 绑定 vs 解耦；b) erase 方向/地址是否共享头；c) 仅加大 decay 或仅加门控是否能复现收益。
3) 机制分析图：作者提到 erase/write 近似正交，通常会有 cosine 相似度分布、寻址相关性随层/头变化等图；这部分能帮助判断它是不是“真正的定点删除”。

预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可完成方法+主结果+关键消融；若要评估可替代 KV-cache 的潜力，需要再花时间看长上下文设置与训练稳定性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In delta-rule linear attention / recurrent associative memory, the corrective edit (erase/correct) is tied to the current write key. This coupling prevents the model from actively deleting stale information stored at a different address before writing new content elsewhere, leaving only address-agnostic decay to “forget” outdated state—problematic for reassignment, correction, and context-shift patterns in language modeling.
summary_en.importance: The paper targets memory management in constant-state sequence models, which matters for long-context pretraining where state pollution accumulates. By adding an independently addressed erase operation, it aims to make delta-rule recurrence behave more like an explicit memory system (separate delete vs write primitives) without reverting to KV-cache. The contribution is a structural update-rule extension (more than a minor gating tweak), though its practical impact depends on whether gains persist at larger scales and longer contexts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Built on channel-wise gated delta / DPLR-style recurrence (diagonal per-channel decay plus low-rank delta updates), the baseline delta rule treats the memory matrix S_t as an associative map and performs a corrective update so that the readout at the current key k_t, i.e., S^T k_t, moves toward v_t.

Erase-then-Delta Attention (EDA) decouples where to erase from where to write:
1) Erase step: select an independent erase address and apply a targeted suppression along a learned erase direction, explicitly cleaning stale content at that address.
2) Delta step: perform the standard delta-style corrective write at the current write key k_t, preserving the desirable “correct-what’s-stored” behavior.

Conceptually, EDA separates three signals: (i) address-agnostic diagonal/channel decay, (ii) independently addressed erasure, and (iii) write-coupled delta correction. The authors report that the learned erase and write addressing becomes nearly orthogonal, suggesting the erase path is not merely stronger forgetting but a distinct conditional cleanup mechanism.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables or numeric results, so model sizes, token counts, and exact improvements cannot be stated reliably. From the introduction, evaluation includes: (i) LM pretraining where EDA improves over a DPLR-style gated-delta baseline and compares against other update-rule variants, (ii) long-context evaluation, and (iii) memory-state probes showing near-orthogonal separation between erase and write addressing.

When reading, verify with ablations that isolate the benefit of independent erasure (vs stronger decay, extra parameters, or additional gating capacity).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus on:
1) The exact EDA update equations: how the erase address is parameterized, how the erase direction is applied to S_t, and whether compute/memory remains O(1) state.
2) Core ablations: erase tied vs untied to write; removing erase; replacing erase with stronger diagonal decay; sharing vs separating heads/parameters.
3) Mechanistic plots: cosine similarity/correlation between erase and write addresses across layers/heads, supporting the “orthogonal roles” claim.

Time budget: ~30–45 minutes for method + main results + key ablations; longer if you want to assess long-context settings and training stability details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看方法和主表：它不是又一个线性注意力小修小补，而是在 memory update rule 上加了“独立擦除”自由度；先查收益是否来自更干净的记忆管理，而不是额外参数或训练技巧。
recommendation.en: Read the method and main tables: this is not just another linear-attention tweak, but a real change to the memory update rule via independent erase; the key question is whether gains come from cleaner memory management rather than extra capacity or training tricks.

paper.title: ATMA: Length-Invariant Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
paper.abstract: Modern large language models based on softmax scaled-dot-product attention are constrained by their training sequence length: as the key-value sequence grows, softmax probability mass can dilute across a wider distribution, inducing activation shift and long-context performance collapse. Moreover, long-context language modeling faces a structural tension: a sliding-window attention core maintains a bounded local representation and low perplexity but is blind to long-range dependencies, while ful

summary.core_problem: ATMA 处理的是长上下文长度外推中的两个耦合问题：softmax attention 在键数量增大后会出现概率质量稀释，导致激活分布偏离训练长度；而滑窗注意力虽然局部困惑度稳定，却丢失窗口外检索能力。作者试图用一种有界的全局读出机制，加上可压缩的长期记忆，同时保住局部语言建模和远距离精确召回。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练动态层面。它不是简单扩大窗口或换位置编码，而是把长上下文失败归因到 attention 输出的尺度和分布漂移，并将“匹配内容”和“匹配数量”显式解耦。这一思路值得关注，因为长上下文预训练常见的问题不是只缺少全局信息，而是全局信息进入 residual stream 的方式会改变模型在训练长度内学到的激活统计。不过实验规模仍偏小，370M、1B tokens 的结论更适合作为架构假设和消融证据，不能直接外推到多十亿参数和万亿 token 训练。
summary.technical_approach: ATMA 是 16 层 decoder-only 模型，采用 3:1 的混合序列混合比例：12 层 LFM2 gated convolution 负责稳定的局部建模，4 层 Polar Attention 提供稀疏插入的全局读出。每个 block 使用 pre-norm，MLP 是 4 倍扩展的 squared-ReLU。核心是三通道 attention 输出。第一是 content channel：对匹配到的 value-sum 做单位球投影，只保留方向，减少上下文长度变化带来的幅度漂移。第二是 count channel：用 participation ratio，也就是 inverse Simpson index，估计有多少 key 参与了匹配，再经过饱和单调映射得到有界计数信号。这样“匹配到了什么”和“匹配了多少”不再混在 softmax 归一化输出里。第三是 memory channel：引入 per-head recurrent associative memory，使用类似 Titans 的 gated-delta update，把长文档趋势压缩成有损记忆。Polar Attention 负责精确全局读出，memory 负责长期语义和困惑度趋势。作者还加入 extreme-value-corrected null floor，用学习到的随机匹配上界校准 logits，避免极长序列中的背景噪声淹没有效匹配。
summary.experiments: 实验包括 100-run factorial ablation。模型规模为 370M，在 1B token FineWeb-Edu 上训练，并在 2K 到 64K 上评估，最长达到训练长度的 32 倍。主要结论是 Polar Attention 和 gated-delta memory 必须组合使用：无 memory 的 Polar Attention 在长距离检索上仍会退化；softmax 加同样 memory 在极长长度下仍有困惑度和激活漂移问题。ATMA 在 2K 到 64K 的 induction needle-in-a-haystack 检索中保持 90% 以上，同时 clean-document perplexity 随上下文变长单调改善。系统实现方面，作者提供 PyTorch reference、FP16/FP8 training harness 和 paged inference engine，并实现 FlashAttention 风格 Triton kernel 来流式计算 participation ratio；gated-delta 训练 recurrence 通过 custom ops 避免 dynamo graph break。报告中称 recurrent memory 分支在 NVIDIA L4 上带来约 4.5 个百分点 MFU 下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 softmax dilution 和滑窗/全局注意力取舍的定义，再看 Methodology 里三通道 Polar Attention 的公式和 gated-delta memory 的接口。实验部分优先看 100-run factorial ablation、2K→64K 长度外推曲线、needle 检索和 clean perplexity 的联合结果。值得深挖的是 participation ratio 是否稳定、null floor 如何估计、content 单位化会不会损失强度信息，以及这些设计在更大 batch、更深模型和真实长文预训练中是否仍然稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: ATMA targets a specific failure mode in long-context language modeling: softmax attention changes its output statistics as the number of keys grows, while sliding-window attention avoids this shift only by giving up recall beyond the window. The goal is to keep local language modeling stable and still support precise retrieval at lengths far beyond training.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is architectural rather than data-related. The work treats long-context collapse as an activation-distribution problem, not only as a positional-encoding or context-size problem. Its main idea is to separate content from count in the attention readout, then add a recurrent compressed memory for long-range document state. The evidence is still small-scale: 370M parameters and 1B training tokens are enough for controlled ablations, but not enough to establish behavior at frontier-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATMA is a 16-layer decoder-only model with a 3:1 hybrid mixing schedule: 12 LFM2 gated convolution layers and 4 Polar Attention layers. The blocks use pre-normalization and a 4x squared-ReLU MLP. Polar Attention replaces the usual softmax readout with three additive streams. The content stream normalizes the matched value sum onto the unit sphere, preserving direction while removing length-dependent magnitude. The count stream estimates how many items participated in the match using the participation ratio, or inverse Simpson index, then bounds it through a saturating monotone map. This explicitly decouples what was matched from how much was matched. The memory stream is a per-head recurrent associative memory with a gated-delta update, inspired by Titans. The recurrent path carries a lossy long-term gist, while Polar Attention provides bounded full-context retrieval. An extreme-value-corrected learned null floor is used to calibrate logits against the expected maximum score from random background matches.
summary_en.experiments: The main study is a 100-run factorial ablation with 370M-parameter models trained on 1B FineWeb-Edu tokens. Models are evaluated from 2K to 64K context length, up to 32 times the training length. The reported pattern is clear: Polar Attention without memory still loses retrieval at long range, and softmax paired with the same memory still collapses at extreme lengths. The full ATMA configuration keeps induction needle-in-a-haystack retrieval above 90% across the 2K-to-64K sweep, while clean-document perplexity improves as more context is available. On the systems side, the implementation includes a PyTorch reference, an FP16/FP8 training harness, a paged inference engine, and a FlashAttention-style Triton kernel for streaming participation-ratio computation. The recurrent memory branch is reported to cost about 4.5 percentage points of MFU on NVIDIA L4 GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30- to 45-minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around softmax dilution and the window-versus-retrieval trade-off first. Then focus on the Polar Attention equations, especially the content normalization, participation-ratio count channel, and null-floor calibration. In the experiments, prioritize the factorial ablations and the 2K-to-64K curves for retrieval and perplexity. The main questions to carry forward are whether the count statistic remains stable at larger scale, whether unit-normalized content loses useful magnitude information, and whether the memory branch interacts cleanly with deeper pretrained models.

recommendation.zh: 这是在正面挑战 softmax attention 长度外推 prior；先看方法图和长上下文曲线，若 baseline 只打滑窗而没打 Hyena/RWKV/linear attention，就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the softmax-attention prior on length extrapolation; read the method figure and long-context curves first, and treat it as weak evidence if the baselines stop at sliding-window attention.

paper.title: Harmonic: Hierarchical State Space Models for Efficient Long-Context Language Modeling
paper.abstract: We present Harmonic, a hierarchical state space model (SSM) for language modeling. The architecture stacks three recurrent levels at progressively slower timescales; each level receives the prediction error of the level below as input, rather than its raw hidden state. On enwiki8 with equal token budgets, Harmonic outperforms a comparable Transformer (28M params) by +1.4% at 1K tokens, +6.7% at 8K tokens, and +11.4% at 32K tokens (bpt, lower is better). It also outperforms Mamba at every tested

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文语言建模中 Transformer 和现有 SSM 在记忆长度、显存占用与长度泛化上的不足。
summary.importance: 这是架构层面的建模尝试，不是简单替换注意力算子。它把分层时间尺度递归和预测误差传递结合起来，目标是同时改善长程依赖建模和训练可扩展性，对“后注意力时代”的长上下文 LM 设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Harmonic，一种分层状态空间模型。模型包含三个递归层级，对应不同时间尺度；上层不直接接收下层隐藏状态，而是接收下层的 prediction error。这个设计更像分层残差预测/误差校正机制，试图让慢时钟层专注于更长程、低频的信息。作者还将 HarmonicBlock 直接替换 TinyLlama 1.1B 中全部 attention 层，构造 Hallamonic，用来测试在更大规模下是否能摆脱 RoPE 的长度限制。
summary.experiments: 在 enwiki8 上，等 token budget 下，相比 28M Transformer，Harmonic 在 1K/8K/32K 上 bpt 分别改善 1.4%/6.7%/11.4%；相对 Mamba 也有 0.7-1.8% 优势。64K 时，Mamba 和 Transformer 在 80GB H100 上无法训练，Harmonic 仍可训练并达到 6.169 bpt。WikiText-103 上也复现了对 Transformer 的优势，1K-32K 区间提升 1.7%-7.2%。在 1.1B 规模，把 TinyLlama 的 attention 全替换后，在 Lambada 等两个 clean benchmark 上 1K-8K 长度范围 loss 更稳定。当前证据主要是中小规模语言建模和一个 attention-free 替换实验，离大规模预训练结论还有距离。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the weakness of Transformers and existing SSMs in long-context language modeling, especially memory usage, context scaling, and length generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural proposal rather than a minor efficiency tweak. By combining hierarchical timescales with prediction-error passing, it offers a concrete alternative for long-context LM design and is relevant to anyone thinking beyond standard attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Harmonic, a hierarchical state space model with three recurrent levels operating at progressively slower timescales. Instead of feeding raw hidden states upward, each level passes prediction errors to the next level. This creates a hierarchical error-correction mechanism intended to separate short-range and long-range dynamics. The authors also replace all attention layers in TinyLlama 1.1B with HarmonicBlock, forming Hallamonic, to test whether the architecture can avoid RoPE-style context limits at larger scale.
summary_en.experiments: On enwiki8 under matched token budgets, Harmonic beats a 28M Transformer by 1.4%, 6.7%, and 11.4% in bpt at 1K, 8K, and 32K respectively, and outperforms Mamba by 0.7-1.8% across tested lengths. At 64K, both Mamba and Transformer run out of memory on an 80GB H100, while Harmonic still trains and reaches 6.169 bpt. The gains replicate on WikiText-103, with a 1.7%-7.2% gap over Transformer from 1K to 32K. At 1.1B scale, replacing TinyLlama attention with HarmonicBlock yields more stable loss across 1K-8K on two clean benchmarks. Evidence is promising but still far from a full large-scale pretraining validation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“长上下文无注意力替代”的弱强信号来看：机制有新意，结果也干净，但规模还不够，重点读误差传递设计和 64K 训练可行性，别急着改 prior。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a serious but still early signal for attention-free long-context LM: the error-passing idea is novel and the 64K result is clean, but scale is not yet enough to rewrite priors.

paper.title: Understanding Parallel Samplers in Masked Diffusion via Random Walks on Graphs
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose using random walks on graphs as a verifiable sandbox to study different parallel sampling strategies in masked diffusion models (MDMs). We train an MDM on random walk samples from a fixed graph. The graph or the transition kernel is never shown to the model explicitly and plays the role of latent structure in the sequences, albeit one that is controllable and can be used for quantitative evaluation. Thus, this framework enjoys a Sudoku-like validity check: verifying tha

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 masked diffusion / masked denoising 里一个很核心、但过去常被经验化处理的问题：并行 unmask 到底什么时候是统计上正确的，什么时候会因为忽略 token 间条件依赖而出错。AR 模型按链式法则逐个采样，理论上顺序怎么排都能精确；MDM 则可以任意顺序、甚至一次揭多个 token，这带来推理加速空间，但也引入了 block conditional 被近似成坐标边缘分布乘积的误差。论文要做的，是把这种误差从语言建模里复杂的模型误差、评测噪声中剥离出来，单独研究 sampler 本身。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇是值得精读的。它的贡献不在于再提一个经验上更好的 schedule，而在于给 masked diffusion 的并行采样建立了一个可验证、可证明、可迁移的分析框架。随机游走图任务像 Sudoku 一样，模型训练时看不到底层约束，但生成后可以精确检查合法性，还能直接估计转移核的分布偏差。这样一来，采样器误差第一次可以被比较干净地量化。更重要的是，论文给出一个明确结论：基于局部不确定性、例如 lowest-entropy 的并行揭示策略，并不存在统一优势；是否有效取决于目标分布的条件依赖结构。这个判断对 MDLM、SEDD、LLaDA 一类 any-order / masked 生成模型都很关键，因为很多工程做法默认“先揭最确定的 token”天然更稳，这篇工作说明并非如此。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层。

第一层是构造 sandbox。作者把图上的随机游走序列当作离散生成任务：节点 ID 是 token，长度为 L 的 walk 是训练样本，模型只从样本学习，从不显式看到图 G 或转移核。评测时则利用图结构做两类精确指标：一是 coherence / validity，检查相邻 token 是否真有边相连；二是 transition TV distance，从生成样本估计转移核，与真实随机游走核比较分布保真度。这个设计的好处是，latent structure 对模型是隐藏的，对研究者却是可控的，因此可以系统改变图密度、瓶颈、端点约束、Markov 阶数，观察采样器行为如何变化。

第二层是理论分析。论文先证明：在 perfect conditionals 下，单坐标 sequential unmasking 是 order-invariant 且精确的，因为它等价于链式分解；但 parallel unmasking 不再有这个性质，因为它把真实 block conditional 近似成多个单点条件分布的乘积，只有在这些坐标条件独立时才精确。作者构造了简单 DAG / graph 例子，证明 lowest-entropy 两两并行揭示有时优于 random，有时反而更差，因此任何只依赖局部 uncertainty score 的策略都不可能 uniformly optimal。关键决定因素不是 token 自身熵，而是 reveal set 内部以及与已知上下文之间的条件分离结构。

第三层是提出 bisection-style sampler。直觉来自 Markov separation：对一阶随机游走，如果先揭示中间位置，它会把左右两段在条件上分开；对 k 阶 Markov walk，则需要揭示一个大小匹配阶数的 separator block。算法上就是先揭中间 separator，再对左右子区间递归并行处理。作者证明，在 perfect conditionals 下，这个 coarse-to-fine schedule 对无条件随机游走和端点条件随机游走都可以做到精确采样；对 order-k 情况，NFE 复杂度是 O(k log(L/k))，并行深度显著低于逐点采样。

论文最后把这个思路迁移到真实文本 MDM。虽然语言不满足显式 Markov 图结构，作者仍然把“先揭能分隔依赖的锚点，再递归细化”当作 schedule 设计原则，在预训练 OpenWebText masked diffusion 模型上测试。这里的意义不在于证明语言也满足同样定理，而在于说明 graph sandbox 学到的 sampler inductive bias 可以转移到自然语言生成。
summary.experiments:
实验分 graph sandbox 和文本生成两部分。

在 graph 部分，作者系统比较 sequential、random parallel、entropy-guided parallel，以及 bisection-style samplers。结果显示 sampler 排名会随图结构翻转：在树或强相关路径结构上，entropy-guided 并行更新容易过早锁定彼此相关的 token，导致 coherence 和分布保真度变差；加入更多 Erdős–Rényi 边后，图中可替代路径增多，先固定低熵锚点反而可能有利。这正好验证理论结论：并行采样质量由条件依赖结构决定，而不是由“低熵优先”单独决定。

对 endpoint-conditioned walks 和 higher-order walks，bisection sampler 的优势更明显，因为中间 separator block 与问题结构直接对应。论文给出的理论复杂度是 O(k log(L/k)) NFEs；实验上它在相近或更低 NFE 下，通常能取得更高的合法性和更低的 transition TV distance。这里最值得注意的不是某个单一数字，而是它在不同图家族、不同约束设置下表现更稳定，说明它利用的是结构，而不是某个数据集偶然性。

在语言模型实验里，作者在 OpenWebText 上训练了 pretrained MDM，并比较不同并行 schedule 的 speed-quality tradeoff。bisection-style schedule 在非自回归生成下，相比常见并行策略，在 MAUVE、generative perplexity、输出熵和 repetition 上都更优或更稳，说明 coarse-to-fine reveal 对自然语言也有帮助。摘要没有给出完整数字，但从全文叙述看，重点是同等或更少 denoiser 调用次数下，质量退化更小，而不是绝对质量超过 AR 基线。

如果从预训练研究角度看，实验最有信息量的地方有两个：一是 higher-order walk 结果，说明当目标分布有更长局部记忆时，separator block 的大小必须跟建模阶数匹配；二是 endpoint-conditioned 设定，它很像带全局约束的填空任务，能更清楚暴露并行乘积分解的失真。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按这个顺序。

先看 Introduction 和 Section 2，弄清楚 graph random walk 为什么是个好 sandbox，以及 coherence / transition TV 这两个指标分别在测什么。这里决定了整篇论文的价值，不只是“换了个 benchmark”。

然后重点读 Section 3 的理论反例。要看明白作者不是在证明 entropy 不好，而是在证明任何局部 uncertainty score 都不可能脱离依赖结构而统一最优。这个结论比某个 sampler 的胜负更重要。

接着精读 Section 4 的 bisection sampler。关注两件事：为什么中间位置或中间 block 能起 separator 作用；以及 exactness 证明依赖的条件是什么。若你做 MDLM / LLaDA / SEDD 一类模型，这部分最值得反复看，因为它直接关系到并行采样 schedule 能否从 heuristic 变成结构化设计。

实验部分建议先看 graph，再看语言。graph 实验里重点看不同图家族导致 sampler 排名翻转的图表，以及 higher-order / endpoint-conditioned 结果。语言实验则看 speed-quality 曲线，不要只盯单点指标。整篇认真读大约需要 60 到 90 分钟；若只抓核心思想，读引言、Section 3、Section 4 和语言实验结论，大约 35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a central question in masked diffusion and other any-order discrete generators: when is parallel unmasking statistically faithful, and when does it fail because it ignores conditional dependence among tokens? In autoregressive sampling, one-token-at-a-time decoding is exact under the chain rule regardless of order. In masked diffusion, revealing multiple coordinates at once replaces a true block conditional with a product of one-coordinate marginals. That approximation is only valid under conditional independence. The paper isolates this sampler error from model error by moving to a controlled setting.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong paper for anyone working on non-AR language modeling. Its main contribution is not just a better heuristic schedule, but a clean framework for reasoning about parallel samplers. The graph random-walk setup gives exact validity checks and direct distribution-fidelity metrics, so sampler behavior can be studied without the usual confounds of open-ended language generation. The key conclusion is important: local uncertainty scores such as lowest entropy are not uniformly reliable guides for parallel unmasking. Their success depends on the conditional-dependence structure of the target distribution. That matters directly for masked diffusion LMs, MDLM-style models, and any-order generation more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three technical layers.

First, it builds a verifiable sandbox. Training data are random walks on a hidden graph. Tokens are node IDs, and the model only sees sampled sequences, never the graph or transition kernel explicitly. At evaluation time, the graph provides exact structure-aware metrics: coherence or validity, meaning whether every adjacent token pair is a legal edge, and transition total variation distance, obtained by estimating the Markov kernel from generated walks and comparing it to the true one. This gives a Sudoku-like setup where latent constraints are hidden during training but exactly testable afterward.

Second, it develops theory for sampler separations. Under perfect conditionals, sequential one-coordinate unmasking is exact and order-invariant because it follows the chain rule. Parallel unmasking is different: it approximates a block conditional by a product of coordinate-wise conditionals, which is exact only when the chosen coordinates are conditionally independent given the current context. The authors construct simple graph and DAG examples showing that lowest-entropy two-at-a-time unmasking can beat random parallel unmasking on some structures and lose on others. This rules out any claim that a purely local uncertainty score is uniformly optimal. The decisive factor is dependence structure, not uncertainty alone.

Third, the paper proposes bisection-style samplers. The idea comes from Markov separation. For first-order walks, revealing a middle position can separate the left and right halves conditionally; for order-k walks, one needs a separator block of size matched to k. The sampler reveals the middle separator, then recurses on the two sides in parallel. Under perfect conditionals, the authors prove exactness for both unconditional and endpoint-conditioned walks. For order-k Markov walks, the number of function evaluations scales as O(k log(L/k)), giving logarithmic parallel depth rather than linear sequential depth.

They then transfer the scheduling idea to a pretrained masked language model on OpenWebText. The claim is not that language literally satisfies the same graph theorem, but that the graph sandbox reveals a useful design principle: reveal dependency-separating anchors first, then refine recursively.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are split between graph walks and natural language generation.

In the graph sandbox, the paper compares sequential decoding, random parallel unmasking, entropy-guided parallel policies, and bisection-style samplers. The main empirical pattern is that sampler rankings flip with graph structure. On trees and strongly coupled path-like graphs, entropy-guided parallel updates often commit too early to correlated choices, hurting coherence and transition fidelity. When extra Erdős–Rényi edges are added, creating many alternative routes, low-entropy anchors can become genuinely useful. This directly supports the theoretical claim that parallel decoding quality is governed by conditional dependence rather than uncertainty alone.

For endpoint-conditioned walks and higher-order walks, bisection-style schedules are especially effective because the separator block aligns with the underlying structure. The theoretical complexity is O(k log(L/k)) NFEs for order-k walks, and empirically these samplers achieve better validity and lower transition TV distance at similar or lower inference cost. The important point is not a single headline number, but the consistency across graph families and constraint settings.

The language experiments use a pretrained masked diffusion model on OpenWebText. There, bisection-style schedules improve the non-autoregressive speed-quality tradeoff over standard parallel schedules across MAUVE, generative perplexity, entropy, and repetition. The paper’s emphasis is not absolute quality against autoregressive baselines, but reduced quality loss at a fixed or lower number of denoiser calls.

From a pretraining perspective, two experimental aspects are especially informative. Higher-order walk results show that separator size must match the effective memory order of the target process. Endpoint-conditioned walks act like globally constrained infilling tasks and make the failure mode of naive parallel factorization much easier to see.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction and preliminaries first to understand why graph random walks are a useful sandbox rather than just a toy benchmark. The evaluation design, especially coherence and transition TV, is central to the paper.

Then spend time on the theoretical separation results. The important lesson is not that entropy is bad, but that no local uncertainty score can be uniformly optimal without accounting for dependence structure. After that, read the bisection sampler section carefully. Focus on why middle positions act as separators, what changes for order-k walks, and exactly which assumptions are needed for the exactness proof.

For experiments, read the graph results before the language results. The graph section makes the mechanism visible; the language section shows transfer. In the language part, look at speed-quality curves rather than isolated metrics.

This is a real must-read for researchers working on masked diffusion or any-order LM inference. A careful read will take about 60 to 90 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读；它提醒 MDLM 采样别迷信 confidence/entropy heuristic，先在可验证结构任务上做 sampler ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading; it warns against trusting confidence or entropy heuristics in MDLM sampling without controlled sampler ablations.

paper.title: FiLM-Coordinated Dual-Branch Transformer for Global-Local Dependency Modeling in Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Standard Transformers use a single self-attention pathway to model both global dependencies and local patterns, creating tension between long-range structural reasoning and fine-grained local representation learning. We propose a FiLM-coordinated dual-branch Transformer for language modeling, where each layer explicitly contains a global branch and a local branch, and feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) is used for dynamic cross-branch coordination instead of simple concatenation or static add

summary.core_problem: 尝试缓解标准 Transformer 用单一路径同时建模全局依赖和局部模式时的表示冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小规模语言建模架构改动：显式拆分 global branch 与 local branch，并用 FiLM 做双向通道调制；属于常规架构探索，不是大规模预训练 recipe 或新语言建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 每层包含全局分支和局部分支，两个分支分别形成对同一输入的不同依赖视角；用 bidirectional FiLM 让一个分支生成 per-channel scale 与 shift 来调制另一个分支，避免简单 concat/static add，也避免重 token-level 交互。
summary.experiments: 在多个小规模 language modeling setting 上评估；摘要称该结构稳定优于同宽单分支 baseline 和削弱版双分支 baseline，但未披露参数量、数据规模、困惑度数值或大模型可扩展性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to reduce the representational tension in standard Transformers, where one self-attention pathway must model both global dependencies and local patterns.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small-scale language-modeling architecture variant: explicit global and local branches coordinated by FiLM. It is a conventional architecture exploration rather than a large-scale pretraining recipe or a new language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each layer has a global branch and a local branch, treated as different dependency views over the same sequence. A bidirectional FiLM module lets each branch produce per-channel scale and shift parameters to condition the other, replacing simple concatenation, static addition, or heavy token-level interaction.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on multiple small-scale language modeling settings. The abstract claims consistent gains over same-width single-branch baselines and weakened dual-branch variants, but does not report parameter counts, data scale, perplexity numbers, or evidence of large-scale transfer.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和消融即可；FiLM 双分支有点意思，但小 LM 结果不足以改变对 Transformer scaling 的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the architecture and ablations only; FiLM dual-branching is mildly interesting, but small-LM evidence should not update priors on Transformer scaling.

paper.title: Attention as Frustrated Synchronization
paper.abstract: A network of oscillators that synchronizes perfectly computes nothing further, so an attention architecture built from synchronization must locate its computation in structured departures from agreement. We introduce the Frustrated Synchronization Network (FSN), whose token states are phases on a torus and whose entire value pathway is one learned complex coupling kernel over harmonics and a one-step delay. Each component of the kernel is a frustration in the sense of the synchronization literat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个注意力变体”，而是更具体的问题：为什么把注意力理解成同步系统之后，Kuramoto-style attention 在重复片段检索很强的场景里仍然落后于标准 Transformer。作者给出的诊断是，普通自注意力沿深度传播时会把 token 表征推向共识，这对“找到相关上下文”是合适的，但对“根据上下文预测下一个符号”并不充分，因为它更像把当前位置拉向被检索片段本身，而不是拉向那个片段之后会发生什么。FSN 试图把 value pathway 从“同步到被关注 token”改成“同步到被关注 token 的后继偏移”，让检索直接服务于续写预测，尤其针对 copy-depth 较深的重复结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给 attention 的一个常见现象——层间表征趋同、秩下降、表示塌缩——提供了更可操作的动力系统解释，并据此提出了可训练、可替换的层设计，而不是停留在分析层面。第二，它提出了一个和标准 dot-product attention 不同的 value 作用机制：query 不是去吸收检索到的内容本身，而是去吸收“检索位置的转移信息”。这件事对语言建模很关键，因为 next-token prediction 关心的是 transition，而不是 retrieval 的静态匹配。量级上，这还不是一个已经证明可扩展到大规模 subword LLM 的方案；作者也明确承认实验停留在 character-level、小模型和较慢训练上。所以它更像一个值得跟踪的建模方向，而不是现成 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，FSN 保留了 Kuramoto attention 的 score map，只改 value/update law。每个 token 的隐状态不是实向量，而是 k 维相位向量，位于环面上；对应的复数表示是单位模 phasor。注意力分数仍由 query/key 相位相干性、门控和 rotary drift 组成，softmax 保持因果约束。核心变化在更新方向。基础 Kuramoto 层的更新是对 attended token 相位做吸引式耦合，形式上是对 sin(theta_u - theta_t) 的加权和，目标是相位一致。FSN 则引入带谐波的复值耦合核，对每个被关注位置 u，不再主要耦合到 z_u，而是耦合到 z_{u+1}，也就是该位置的后继 token 状态。作者证明，这等价于 Kuramoto–Sakaguchi 耦合里引入一个 frustration angle，而这个角度不是手工参数，而是由数据自身的局部转移 delta_u = theta_{u+1} - theta_u 决定。这样一来，模型不是把当前位置拉向“和检索片段一致”，而是拉向“相对检索片段应当偏移多少”。

更细一点看，FSN 的更新核包含两部分：w0 对当前 attended token 的静态 frustrated coupling，w1 对 successor 的一阶延迟耦合；两者都支持多个谐波 n=1..N，默认 N=3，系数是逐坐标的复数。极坐标下，模长对应 harmonic gain，相位对应 frustration angle，因此每个系数都能直接映射到同步文献中的耦合对象。这个设计的一个优点是可解释性比普通 MLP value mixing 更强。另一个优点是它严格包含若干特例：N=1, w0=1, w1=0 退化回 Kuramoto attention；更一般的实系数对应 Daido harmonic coupling；w0=0 则是纯 successor coupling。作者还讨论了初始化问题：当 frustration angle 全在零附近时，角度方向存在局部对称，早期优化容易不稳定，因此初始化需要打破这种对称性。文中还有一个去掉 FFN 的变体，用对 learned collective modes 的 gated coupling 替代前馈层，想测试性能到底来自 frustrated coupling 还是来自常规 Transformer block 的其余部分。
summary.experiments:
实验集中在 character-level language modeling，数据包括 enwik8 文本和 character-level code，主打 matched-parameter、matched-epoch 对比。最关键的结果是：在约 1M 参数规模上，FSN 在 enwik8 的验证损失优于调好的 Transformer，matched epochs 下是 1.6050 vs 1.6258 bits per character，充分收敛后是 1.5953 vs 1.611。作者没有只给总 loss，而是做了 copy-depth decomposition：按当前位置结尾子串在历史中出现过的最长匹配长度分桶。这个分析很有信息量，因为 attention 的优势通常就体现在长重复结构上。Kuramoto attention 相比 Transformer 的劣势主要集中在高 copy-depth 区间，最差可落后 +0.4231 bpc；FSN 则在 depth≥4 的每个 bin 上都反超 Transformer，说明 successor-based frustrated coupling 确实修复了“会检索但不会顺着检索做预测”的问题。

扩展性方面，作者做了参数翻倍阶梯，到 8M 参数时 matched-epoch 优势仍在。训练速度是明显代价：FSN 每个 epoch 慢数倍。但若按 wall-clock 比较达到 Transformer 平均损失所需时间，在 4M 和 8M 时 FSN 反而只需 0.70× 时间，在 1M 和 2M 时则分别需要 1.23× 和 1.56×。这说明它单步更贵，但在较大规模上收敛效率有补偿。去掉 FFN 的变体在 enwik8 上做到 1.6452 bpc，而对应 Transformer 是 1.6258，说明 frustrated coupling 本身已经能承担相当一部分建模能力，但完整 FSN 仍明显更强。论文也坦率指出局限：全部结果都在字符级，尚未验证 subword tokenizer、长上下文、大模型和现代大规模训练配方下是否成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 copy-depth 分析动机，理解作者为什么认为“共识适合检索，不适合预测”。这是整篇最关键的判断。然后看 FSN 主公式，重点不是把每个复数符号都算清，而是抓住两件事：一是 successor coupling 替代 direct coupling；二是 frustration angle 由数据转移给出，而不是额外学习一个静态偏移。接着看 Proposition 1 附近的推导，确认“耦合到后继”等价于带数据依赖 frustration 的 Sakaguchi coupling。实验部分建议优先看 enwik8 主表、copy-depth 分桶图、参数扩展和 wall-clock 对比，这几处最能说明方法到底修复了什么、代价是什么。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成有效泛读。如果要深挖，值得继续看初始化讨论和无 FFN 变体，因为这两处分别关系到训练稳定性和架构归因。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in synchronization-based attention: if self-attention can be viewed as a consensus-forming dynamical system, why does Kuramoto-style attention still underperform a standard Transformer precisely on the repetitive regimes where attention should matter most? The authors argue that consensus is good for retrieval but misaligned with next-token prediction. Pulling a token toward the retrieved context tells the model where a similar pattern occurred, but not what came next. FSN changes the target of synchronization from the attended token itself to the successor of the attended token, so retrieval is turned into a transition-aware predictive signal.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is more conceptual than immediately recipe-level. First, it turns the often-discussed phenomena of representation clustering, rank loss, and layerwise collapse into an actionable modeling hypothesis: attention behaves like synchronization, and prediction may require frustrated rather than attractive coupling. Second, it proposes a different value-pathway semantics for language modeling. Instead of absorbing retrieved content, the model absorbs the offset implied by what followed that content. That is directly relevant to autoregressive modeling, where transitions matter more than static matches. The contribution is still early-stage. Results are limited to character-level modeling, small parameter counts, and slower training, so this is not yet evidence for a scalable replacement of Transformer attention in large subword LMs. It is better read as a serious modeling direction with a clean mechanistic argument.
summary_en.technical_approach:
FSN keeps the score map from the base Kuramoto attention and replaces the update law. Token states live on a k-dimensional torus as phase vectors, with unit-modulus complex phasors as the working representation. Attention scores are still computed from phase coherence, learned gates, and rotary phase drift, under a causal softmax. The main change is in how attended information acts on the current token.

In the base Kuramoto layer, the update is an attractive coupling term, a weighted sum of sin(theta_u - theta_t), which pushes phases toward agreement with attended tokens. FSN replaces this with a harmonic complex-valued coupling kernel and a one-step delay. For an attended position u, the model can couple not only to z_u but also to z_{u+1}, the successor state. The key theoretical point is that coupling to the successor is equivalent to Kuramoto-Sakaguchi coupling with a frustration angle given by the data transition delta_u = theta_{u+1} - theta_u. So the offset is not a free learned bias; it is induced by the sequence itself. This turns the layer from consensus-seeking to transition-seeking.

The kernel has two parts: a static frustrated coupling term over the attended token itself, and a delayed coupling term over successors. Both are expanded over harmonics n=1..N, with per-coordinate complex coefficients; the default uses N=3. In polar form, magnitudes are harmonic gains and phases are frustration angles, which makes the layer unusually interpretable relative to standard value mixing. The construction strictly contains several special cases: standard Kuramoto attention when N=1, w0=1, w1=0; Daido-style harmonic coupling for real coefficients; and pure successor coupling when w0=0. The paper also discusses an initialization issue: zero frustration angles create local symmetries in the early loss surface, so initialization must break that symmetry. A variant without the FFN replaces the feed-forward block with gated coupling to learned collective modes, to test how much of the gain comes from the coupling law itself.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are character-level language modeling on text and code, with matched-parameter and matched-epoch comparisons. The headline result is on enwik8 at roughly 1M parameters: FSN beats a tuned Transformer at matched epochs, 1.6050 vs 1.6258 bits per character, and also after convergence, 1.5953 vs 1.611. The most informative analysis is the copy-depth decomposition, where positions are bucketed by the longest suffix that appeared earlier in context. This is exactly the regime where attention is expected to help. Kuramoto attention loses badly to the Transformer in high copy-depth bins, by as much as +0.4231 bpc. FSN reverses that pattern and outperforms the Transformer in every bin with depth four or greater. That strongly supports the paper’s central claim: successor-based frustrated coupling fixes a predictive deficiency rather than merely improving average optimization.

The authors also run a parameter-doubling ladder up to 8M parameters, where the matched-epoch advantage persists. Training cost is the main downside. FSN is several times slower per epoch. However, when measured by wall-clock time to reach the Transformer’s mean loss, FSN needs only 0.70x the time at 4M and 8M, while requiring 1.23x and 1.56x at 1M and 2M. So the layer is more expensive per step, but some of that is recovered through faster convergence at larger scales. The no-FFN variant reaches 1.6452 bpc on enwik8 versus 1.6258 for the Transformer baseline, suggesting the frustrated coupling itself carries substantial modeling power, though the full FSN remains clearly better. The paper is explicit about its limits: no subword tokenization, no large-scale models, and no evidence yet under modern large-LM training settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the motivation around copy-depth. The central idea is not the oscillator formalism by itself, but the claim that consensus helps retrieval while prediction needs an offset relative to retrieved context. Then read the main FSN update equation with two questions in mind: why successor coupling matters, and why the frustration angle being data-induced is different from learning a static phase shift. The proposition connecting successor coupling to Sakaguchi-style frustration is worth reading carefully, since it is the theoretical hinge of the method. In the experiments, prioritize the main enwik8 table, the copy-depth breakdown, the scaling ladder, and the wall-clock comparison. Those sections tell you what was fixed, what it costs, and where the gains come from. A useful skim should take about 30 to 45 minutes. If going deeper, the initialization discussion and the no-FFN ablation are the best places to probe training stability and architectural attribution.

recommendation.zh: 从同步动力学重构注意力的概念性工作，重点看§3耦合核设计与标准注意力的等价性推导，小模型结果仅作初步参考
recommendation.en: Conceptual work reframing attention via frustrated synchronization; focus on §3 coupling kernel design and equivalence to standard attention, small-scale results are preliminary

paper.title: Simplifying the Modeling of Arbitrary Conditionals in Natural Language
paper.abstract: Causal Transformers model sequences through an autoregressive factorization of the joint distribution, which enables efficient left-to-right decoding and conditional likelihood computation. However, they cannot tractably sample from or evaluate arbitrary conditionals -- e.g., a block of text conditioned on past and future tokens. Recent work aims to solve this problem through novel architectures, but they often lead to sub-optimal modeling of such conditionals and degraded generations. We propos

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 causal Transformer 不能直接建模任意条件分布的问题。标准 GPT 可以高效计算 p(x_{>t}|x_{≤t})，但如果条件集合来自未来、两侧上下文或任意位置，例如文本 infilling、局部改写、在已知结论约束下补全中间推理，直接用自回归分解会遇到不可 tractable 的边缘化问题。论文目标不是另做一个 BERT 式去噪模型，而是在保留 GPT 左到右建模能力的同时，让同一个 decoder-only Transformer 能单次前向计算和采样 p(x_e|x_c)。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把“任意条件语言建模”拉回到标准 causal LM 的工程路径上。它没有引入复杂的新架构，而是通过条件 token 复制和 attention mask 设计，让 GPT 同时支持传统 next-token likelihood 和任意条件 likelihood。对预训练研究的影响主要有三点：第一，它提供了一种比 masked LM 更接近自回归链式分解的 infilling 训练目标；第二，它说明 arbitrary conditional 并不一定要牺牲左到右生成质量；第三，它给现有 LLM 增加未来上下文条件能力提供了可微调路径，而不是从头训练专用模型。
summary.technical_approach:
ac-gpt 的核心做法很简单：给定原序列 x，将 token 分为 conditioning set x_c 和 evaluation set x_e。模型只对 x_e 中的 token 计算预测损失，x_c 因为已知，不能纳入 loss。为了让所有待预测 token 都能看到任意位置的条件 token，方法把 x_c 复制一份放到序列“开头”，记为 \bar{x}_c。这些复制 token 在 attention 顺序上位于最前面，因此后续 token 都能 attend 到它们；但它们保留原始位置编码，所以模型知道条件 token 在原文中的位置。复制的条件 token 之间使用双向 attention，因为它们都已观测，不存在泄漏问题。evaluation token 仍然沿原始顺序使用 causal attention，并按左到右链式分解计算联合概率。

关键细节是为什么必须复制条件 token，而不是直接允许所有 token attend 到原序列里的 x_c。论文指出，如果直接开放对原始条件 token 的 attention，多层 Transformer 会产生间接信息泄漏。例如 x_3 是条件 token，x_1、x_2、x_4 是待评估 token。x_3 为了预测 x_4 需要看到 x_1、x_2；但下一层中 x_1 又可能通过 x_3 间接获得 x_2 信息，破坏 p(x_e|x_c) 内部左到右分解。复制条件 token 能把“已知上下文”和“原序列自回归状态”分离开，避免这种跨层泄漏。

与 BERT/denoising LM 的区别在于，ac-gpt 不是独立预测 masked token，也不是用伪似然近似联合分布。它仍然保留 evaluation tokens 的自回归链式建模，因此可以给 arbitrary conditional 一个一致的 joint likelihood。与需要改架构的任意顺序模型相比，它更接近现有 GPT 训练和推理栈，微调现有 LLM 的成本也更低。
summary.experiments:
论文报告了三类核心结果。第一，在多种 conditional likelihood 评测中，ac-gpt 优于现有 arbitrary conditional baseline，并且没有明显损害标准 left-to-right language modeling。这个结果很关键，因为许多 bidirectional 或 permutation-based 方法在条件任务上可用，但会牺牲普通自回归建模质量。第二，在采样任务上，ac-gpt 生成质量优于只做局部掩码预测或使用专门架构的方法，说明保留 left-to-right 分解对自然语言生成仍然重要。第三，论文展示了从已有 LLM 微调到 ac-gpt 的可行性，说明这种能力可以作为模型能力扩展，而不一定要求重新预训练。

从给定内容能确认的实现细节包括：模型基于 GPT-2 风格 decoder-only Transformer，位置编码使用 RoPE；训练时随机构造 conditioning/evaluation partition，loss 只作用在 evaluation set；conditioning copies 保留原始位置编码，并在条件副本内部使用非因果 attention。给定内容没有包含完整实验表格，无法可靠给出具体参数规模、数据量和各 benchmark 的精确数值。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读方法部分和 Figure 1。重点看三个点：一是 conditioning token copy 的构造方式；二是 copy token 为什么保留原始位置编码；三是防止多层 attention 间接泄漏的例子。这个例子是理解论文的关键。

实验部分建议优先看 conditional likelihood、infilling/text editing sampling、left-to-right LM 保持能力这三组结果。如果有消融表，重点看去掉 copy mechanism、改用原始条件 token attention、去掉条件副本内部双向 attention、改变 partition 策略后的差异。真正值得深挖的是训练分布设计：conditioning set 的采样比例、span/block 条件与随机 token 条件的混合、以及这种 objective 是否能在大规模 continued pretraining 中稳定提升 infilling 和 reasoning-to-known-target 能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of causal Transformers: they can efficiently model left-to-right conditionals such as p(x_{>t}|x_{≤t}), but they cannot tractably evaluate or sample arbitrary conditionals p(x_e|x_c) when the observed tokens may come from the future, from both sides, or from an arbitrary subset of positions. The target use cases include infilling, local text editing, and generation under a known conclusion. The goal is to add this capability without abandoning the standard decoder-only GPT formulation.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a practical route to arbitrary conditional language modeling that stays close to the causal LM stack. Instead of replacing GPT with a denoising model or a specialized architecture, ac-gpt modifies the input layout and attention pattern so that a causal Transformer can compute arbitrary conditional likelihoods in one forward pass. For pretraining research, this matters because it gives a clean objective for infilling-style capabilities while preserving next-token modeling. It also suggests a realistic continued-training path for adding future-context conditioning to existing LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Given a sequence x, the method partitions tokens into a conditioning set x_c and an evaluation set x_e. The loss is applied only to tokens in x_e, since tokens in x_c are observed. ac-gpt creates a copy of the conditioning tokens, \bar{x}_c, and places these copies at the beginning of the attention order. All later tokens can attend to them. The copied tokens keep their original positional encodings, so the model knows where the observed tokens belong in the original sequence. The copied conditioning tokens use unrestricted bidirectional attention among themselves because they are all observed.

The evaluation tokens still follow the original left-to-right causal factorization. This is the main distinction from masked or denoising LMs: ac-gpt does not independently predict masked tokens and does not rely on a pseudo-likelihood approximation. It models the joint distribution over the evaluation set through an autoregressive chain, conditioned on an arbitrary observed subset.

The copy mechanism is not a cosmetic detail. If the model simply allowed every token to attend to the original conditioning tokens, multi-layer attention could leak information between evaluation tokens. For example, a conditioning token at position 3 may need to attend to positions 1 and 2 in order to predict position 4; in the next layer, position 1 could then indirectly receive information about position 2 through position 3. This violates the intended left-to-right factorization over x_e. Separating copied observed tokens from the original autoregressive stream avoids this leakage.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improvements over existing arbitrary-conditional baselines on conditional likelihood evaluation and conditional sampling, while maintaining standard left-to-right modeling quality. This is the central empirical point: the method improves infilling and mixed-context conditioning without paying the usual cost of weakening autoregressive generation.

The provided text confirms the following implementation details: the model uses a GPT-2-style decoder-only Transformer with RoPE; training samples arbitrary partitions of a sequence into conditioning and evaluation tokens; the loss is computed only on evaluation tokens; copied conditioning tokens retain their original positions and attend bidirectionally among themselves. The supplied content does not include the full numeric result tables, so exact model sizes, data scales, and benchmark deltas cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the modeling section and Figure 1 closely. The important parts are the construction of copied conditioning tokens, the use of original positional encodings for those copies, and the leakage example that motivates why direct attention to original conditioning tokens is invalid.

For experiments, focus on three result groups: arbitrary conditional likelihood, infilling or text-editing samples, and standard left-to-right LM quality. If the paper includes ablations, the most informative ones are removing the copy mechanism, changing the attention mask, disabling bidirectional attention among copied conditioning tokens, and varying the conditioning-set sampling strategy. The main open question worth probing is how this objective behaves under large-scale continued pretraining and whether it improves tasks that require conditioning on a known future target.

recommendation.zh: 应细读方法细节：若兼容旧 LLM 的说法成立，AR 模型做任意条件生成的 prior 需要调整。
recommendation.en: Read the method carefully: if compatibility with existing LLMs holds, the prior on arbitrary conditional generation for AR models should move.

paper.title: A Continuous-Time Markov Chain Framework for Insertion Language Models
paper.abstract: Insertion Language Models (ILMs) offer several advantages over left-to-right generation and mask-based generation. However, existing formulations of insertion-based generation have largely been ad-hoc. In this paper, we derive a diffusion-style denoising objective for ILMs from first principles by formulating the noising process as a continuous-time Markov chain on the space of variable-length sequences. We show that previous formulations of ILMs can be viewed as special cases of this denoising

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是给 Insertion Language Models 一个严谨的生成建模框架。已有 ILM 能在任意位置插入 token，适合规划、子目标补全和相对顺序约束，但训练目标和采样过程多是经验设计。它既不像 AR LM 那样有清楚的左到右似然分解，也不像 diffusion / masked LM 那样有统一的正向加噪、反向去噪和 likelihood lower bound。论文要解决的就是：如何在可变长度序列空间上定义连续时间加噪过程，并由此推导插入式生成的反向过程、训练目标和采样方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在建模范式层面。它把 ILM 放进 CTMC diffusion 的统一语言里，使“删除 token 的正向过程”和“插入 token 的反向过程”形成一对概率过程。这比把插入顺序当作启发式策略更干净，也让 ILM 和 D3PM、SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA 一类离散 diffusion / masked generation 工作可以直接比较。贡献量级不是大规模 recipe 或 scaling law，而是给 any-order、可变长度、非左到右语言建模提供了一个可分析的目标函数。对关心 AR 替代范式的人，它的价值在于明确了 ILM 为什么不同于 masked diffusion：ILM 不需要把长度问题塞进 PAD token 预测，而是把长度增长作为反向 CTMC 的一部分来建模。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从连续时间马尔可夫链出发，把状态空间定义为所有可变长度 token 序列。正向 noising process 从真实序列开始，以时间相关速率随机删除 token，最终到达一个参考分布。反向生成过程则从参考分布出发，通过若干 jump 不断插入 token，直到得到完整序列。关键公式是 CTMC 的时间反转率：反向 rate 由正向 rate 和时间边缘分布之比决定；真实边缘不可得时，用参数化的反向 rate 近似，并推导数据 log-likelihood 的 evidence lower bound。论文提出两类参数化。第一类是 joint insertion parameterization：模型一次预测一个插入事件，即插入位置和词表 token 的联合分布，同时建模剩余长度或 length-to-go。这个版本更接近经典 insertion transformer，也更容易解释单步插入决策。第二类是 factorized / independent parameterization：把多个插入维度近似独立建模，从而允许一次采样多个插入事件，减少纯单 token 插入带来的采样步数。这个版本更接近 masked diffusion 的并行生成能力，但仍保留 ILM 的可变长度序列建模。与既有 ILM 的区别在于，插入顺序、训练目标和采样规则不再是单独指定的工程选择，而是从正向删除过程和反向 CTMC 的 ELBO 中导出。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成规划任务和语言建模任务。合成规划实验主要检验 ILM 的结构优势：当任务要求先生成子目标、再补全中间步骤，或需要遵守相对顺序约束时，左到右 AR 模型会被生成顺序限制，masked diffusion 又会受到定长 block 和 PAD 建模影响；CTMC-ILM 保留任意位置插入能力，因此在这类任务上优于 AR 和 masked diffusion 基线。语言建模实验显示，diffusion-style ILM 相比已有经验式 ILM 和 MDM 有更稳定的表现，并能接近左到右 LM。需要注意，实验更像是范式验证，而不是大规模预训练结论；参数规模、数据规模和绝对困惑度需要结合论文表格核对，不应直接外推到 trillion-token 训练。消融的核心看点是两类反向 rate 参数化、单插入与多插入采样、长度建模方式，以及采样步数对质量和速度的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，CTMC background 和 likelihood lower bound 推导，这是理解整篇工作的基础，重点看时间反转 rate、正向删除过程如何诱导反向插入过程。第二，noising process 与 reverse-rate parameterization，尤其是 joint insertion 和 independent insertion 两个版本的差异：前者更精确，后者更适合并行采样。第三，采样算法和计算复杂度部分，重点看如何在可变长度状态空间中避免枚举所有序列，以及如何把连续时间过程离散化为可训练、可采样的算法。实验部分可重点看合成规划任务的设置，因为它更清楚地暴露 ILM 相对 AR 和 MDM 的归纳偏置。附录中的 ELBO 推导、符号表和实现细节值得跟着公式走一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a missing probabilistic foundation for Insertion Language Models. ILMs generate by inserting tokens at arbitrary positions, which makes them useful for planning, infilling, and tasks with relative-order constraints. Prior ILM objectives and samplers were mostly heuristic. The central question is how to define a principled noising process over variable-length sequences and derive the insertion generator, training loss, and sampler from that process.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual and objective-level rather than a large-scale training recipe. It recasts insertion-based generation as a continuous-time Markov chain diffusion process, where forward corruption deletes tokens and reverse generation inserts them. This gives ILMs a common language with discrete diffusion and masked language models, while preserving a key advantage over masked diffusion: sequence length is generated through insertions rather than represented indirectly through PAD tokens. For pretraining research, the value is in making any-order, variable-length language modeling easier to analyze and compare against AR, D3PM-style, SEDD-style, and masked diffusion approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: The state space is the countable set of all finite token sequences. The forward process starts from a data sequence and randomly drops tokens with a time-dependent rate. The reverse process starts from a reference distribution and grows the sequence through insertion jumps. Using CTMC time reversal, the ideal reverse rate can be written in terms of the forward rate and time marginals; since the marginals are unknown, the work parameterizes the reverse rate with Transformer models and derives an evidence lower bound on the data likelihood. Two reverse parameterizations are proposed. The first models a single insertion event, including the joint distribution over insertion position and vocabulary item, together with the remaining length. This connects directly to earlier insertion transformers. The second uses an independent, per-dimension factorization that allows multiple insertions in one sampling step, trading exactness for parallel generation. The main difference from earlier ILMs is that the insertion order, denoising objective, and sampler are derived from a single CTMC construction rather than specified separately.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include a synthetic planning task and language modeling. The planning task is the more diagnostic setting: when generation benefits from placing subgoals first and filling intermediate steps later, left-to-right models are restricted by their order, while masked diffusion has to handle length through fixed blocks and PAD prediction. The CTMC-based ILM keeps the flexible insertion bias and outperforms AR and masked-diffusion baselines in this setting. On language modeling, the diffusion-style ILM is reported to improve over earlier ILM and MDM variants and to be competitive with left-to-right modeling. The evidence should be read as a controlled validation of the modeling framework, not as a scaling result.
